scripts.lint: eslint && echo Lint Checks successfully completed!
scripts.lint:fix: eslint --fix && echo Lint Checks successfully completed!
scripts.typecheck: tsc --pretty --noEmit && echo Type Checks successfuly completed!
scripts.format: prettier --write "**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx,mdx}" --cache && echo Prettier Format successfully completed!
scripts.code-quality: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && echo Code Quality successfully completed!
